'''Andross''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] operator on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Namore]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked with the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Hailey LaMelle]].<ref name="HR">{{WEGCite|story=Live And In (Bleeding) Color&hellip;|book=Heroes & Rogues|stext=Live And In (Bleeding) Color&hellip;}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Andross appeared in "[[Live And In (Bleeding) Color&hellip;]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
